For r>D*lambda1 the positive first-mode Jacobi sn Dirichlet equilibrium exists uniquely because 2K(m)*sqrt(D(1+m)/r) increases strictly from pi*sqrt(D/r) to infinity; a positive stationary sine subsolution excludes zero omega-limit, Allen–Cahn energy plus parabolic compactness yields the selected equilibrium. N=52,a=-1/2,D=.01,L=2*pi gives 1/104<.01, hence homogenization. Finite source checker/experiments are corroborative only.
